verdict.rationale: Pilot's own docs say customers switching providers get onboarding handled by a dedicated accounting expert, and that customers can keep their existing QuickBooks account and historical data. This covers continuity for QuickBooks users, but there is no explicit migration process for other systems and no stated guarantee that transaction-level detail is preserved. Missing for 10: documented migration from non-QuickBooks accounting systems, explicit preservation of transaction-level detail, independent or hands-on corroboration of a historical migration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can migrate historical books from another accounting system without losing transaction detail

citations.quote: Keep your existing QuickBooks account and historical data
Whether you’re starting fresh or switching providers, your dedicated accounting expert is with you from day one handling onboarding
